hero.title: The Saltings
hero.logline: When a body surfaces in the oyster beds of a Kent harbour town, a disgraced harbourmaster must police the tide that once ruined her, knowing every family on the quay owes the sea a secret.

world_and_engine.synopsis: Morwen Hale lost her licence and her marriage the night a fishing boat went down under her watch. Twelve years on she runs the harbour office nobody else wants, until the low tide gives up a man everyone swore had emigrated. The town closes ranks. Morwen opens the books.
world_and_engine.the_engine: The tide is the procedural clock. Each episode turns on what the sea returns or takes between two low tides, while the harbour ledger, a century of debts, smuggling and favours, seeds a new case every season. Morwen cannot leave the water, and the water never stops delivering.
world_and_engine.why_now: Coastal towns are being priced out, flooded and remade in the same decade. The Saltings treats gentrification, climate and inherited guilt as crime-scene evidence rather than background.

mood_stills.caption: Low tide, first light. The body line drawn in silt.
Harbour office at night, ledgers lit by sodium lamps.
Weatherboard houses, sea fog, a town that watches back.

casting.character_bio: Former harbourmaster, now clerk of the office she once ran. Knows every hull and every lie on the quay.
casting.casting_notes: Stillness over volume. A low, unhurried voice that makes silence an accusation. Needs physical ease on boats and the ability to hold a two-hander without blinking.

casting.archetype: The outsider with a mortgage to pay
casting.character_bio: Seconded from Medway, bought a flat on the front, and is fast learning that the town does not want her answers.
casting.casting_notes: Quick, bright, slightly too eager. Counterweight to Morwen's stillness. Chemistry read essential.

episodic_arc.title: Low Water
episodic_arc.hook: A man declared emigrated is found in the oyster beds.
episodic_arc.synopsis: Morwen spots what the police miss: the knots on the body are hers, from a boat she lost twelve years ago.

episodic_arc.title: The Ledger
episodic_arc.hook: The harbour books have a missing year.
episodic_arc.synopsis: Kit pushes for warrants; Morwen pushes for the one family that kept the old ledgers.

episodic_arc.title: Spring Tide
episodic_arc.hook: A second body, and the tide is running higher than records allow.
episodic_arc.synopsis: The case turns from murder to cover-up as the sea wall contract surfaces.
